user.title: Set up FF Agent
user.description: One entry belongs to exactly one person. Nothing is sent to FF Agent.

data_description.name: Label for this entry, for example your name.
data_description.reply_url: Open the FF Agent web UI, go to Persons > your name > section "Übung/Einsatz" (exercise/operation) > "Weblinks für Einsatzmeldung" (web links for mission reply) and copy the accept URL here. The URL only applies to you and to the currently active mission. It is a secret: anyone who has it can accept or decline on your behalf. Do not share it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure FF Agent
reconfigure.description:
Here you can replace the mission reply URL (for example after you regenerated the UUID in FF Agent) or regenerate the webhook access. If you leave both fields unchanged, nothing happens. Nothing is sent to FF Agent.

Saving reloads the integration; an alarm that is active at that moment is reset.

data_description.reply_url: Only fill this in if the URL has changed. Empty means unchanged. The current URL is not shown because it is a secret.
data_description.regenerate_webhook: Creates a new webhook address and a new token. The old access stops working, and you have to enter both in FF Agent afterwards. Useful if the address has become known, or if an external URL or Nabu Casa was added after the setup.

error.invalid_reply_url: This is not a valid mission reply URL. It contains /app2/missionreplies/ and ends with /accept or /reject.
error.cloud_not_connected: Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) is set up but currently not connected. Check the connection and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while creating the webhook URL. Details are in the Home Assistant log but contain no addresses. Please try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this mission reply URL is already in progress.
abort.already_configured: FF Agent is already set up for this mission reply URL.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The configuration is saved. If something changed, the integration is reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_successful_new_webhook:
The webhook access is renewed, the old access is no longer valid. Now replace the URL of the webhook in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks) with this one: `{webhook_url}`

If you use the additional token, replace the header as well: name `{token_header}`, value `{token}`. While the token is required, Home Assistant rejects alarms until the new header is entered in FF Agent.

The URL and the token are secrets. Enter them only in FF Agent.

If the address is only an internal one or just a path, FF Agent cannot reach it. Set up an external URL or Nabu Casa and regenerate the access again.

The integration is reloaded; an alarm that is active at that moment is reset.

create_entry.cloud:
Setup is complete. Now create a webhook in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks > Add webhook) with these values:

- Type: Alarm
- Webhook type: Generic webhook
- Method: POST
- URL: `{webhook_url}`
- Active: on
- Also for test alarms: on (for testing; automations then also run for test alarms)
- Also for info alarms: off
- Schedule enabled: off
- Basic authentication, content and query parameters: empty

The URL is a secret. Enter it only in FF Agent.
create_entry.external:
Setup is complete. Now create a webhook in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks > Add webhook) with these values:

- Type: Alarm
- Webhook type: Generic webhook
- Method: POST
- URL: `{webhook_url}`
- Active: on
- Also for test alarms: on (for testing; automations then also run for test alarms)
- Also for info alarms: off
- Schedule enabled: off
- Basic authentication, content and query parameters: empty

The URL is a secret. Enter it only in FF Agent.
create_entry.internal:
**Warning:** Home Assistant has no external URL and no Nabu Casa connection. FF Agent cannot reach this internal address: `{webhook_url}`

Set up an external URL or Nabu Casa first. Then open the menu "Reconfigure" of this entry and enable "Regenerate webhook access" so that a reachable address is created. Only then create a webhook in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks > Add webhook):

- Type: Alarm
- Webhook type: Generic webhook
- Method: POST
- URL: the new address
- Active: on
- Also for test alarms: on (for testing; automations then also run for test alarms)
- Also for info alarms: off
- Schedule enabled: off
- Basic authentication, content and query parameters: empty
create_entry.path_only:
**Warning:** Home Assistant has neither an external nor an internal URL and no Nabu Casa connection. This entry only knows the path `{webhook_url}`, which is of no use to FF Agent.

Set up an external URL or Nabu Casa first. Then open the menu "Reconfigure" of this entry and enable "Regenerate webhook access" so that a complete address is created. Only then create a webhook in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks > Add webhook):

- Type: Alarm
- Webhook type: Generic webhook
- Method: POST
- URL: the new address
- Active: on
- Also for test alarms: on (for testing; automations then also run for test alarms)
- Also for info alarms: off
- Schedule enabled: off
- Basic authentication, content and query parameters: empty

init.title: FF Agent: Options
init.description:
**Webhook access for FF Agent**

- URL: `{webhook_url}`
- Kind of address: `{url_kind}` (cloud = Nabu Casa, external = external URL, internal = internal only, path_only = path only)
- Header name: `{token_header}`
- Token: `{token}`

In FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks) use these values: Type Alarm, Webhook type Generic webhook, Method POST, the URL from above, Active on, Schedule off, Basic authentication, content and query parameters empty. You only need the header with the token if "Require additional token" below is on.

If the kind is `internal` or `path_only`, FF Agent cannot reach the address. Set up an external URL or Nabu Casa, then enable "Regenerate webhook access" in the "Reconfigure" menu of this entry.

The URL and the token are secrets. Do not share them or screenshots of this page.

**Saving reloads the integration; an alarm that is active at that moment is reset.**

data_description.require_token: Only turn this on once the header is entered in FF Agent and a test alarm shows `x-ff-agent-token` under `header_names` in the diagnostics. Recommended if automations control gates or doors. Calls without a valid token are rejected then.
data_description.reset_minutes: Minutes without a new alarm after which "Alarm active" turns off again (1 to 1440).
data_description.default_transport: Sent with an acceptance if the action does not name a transport.
data_description.location_entity: Optional: a person or device tracker whose location is sent with an acceptance. Leave empty to send no location.

reply_connection_error.message: FF Agent could not be reached or did not answer in time. The reply was probably not sent. Check the internet connection and try again.

reply_http_error.message: FF Agent answered with HTTP status {status}. The reply was probably not recorded. Check in FF Agent whether a reply is possible for the current mission.

invalid_transport.message: The mode of transport "{transport}" is not supported. Supported are car, feet (on foot) and bicycle.

accept.name: Accept
accept.description: Accepts the current mission for one person. Without a mode of transport the default of the entry is used; a location is only sent if you enter it here or set a location entity in the options.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The FF Agent entry of the person who accepts.

transport.name: Mode of transport
transport.description: How the person gets to the mission: by car, on foot or by bicycle.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the current location. Needs the longitude as well. Leave both empty to send no location.

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the current location. Needs the latitude as well.

reject.name: Decline
reject.description: Declines the current mission for one person.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: The FF Agent entry of the person who declines.

webhook_token_rejected.title: FF Agent webhook call rejected
webhook_token_rejected.description:
A call to the FF Agent webhook of "{title}" was rejected because the header X-FF-Agent-Token was missing or wrong. An alarm may have been lost.

Check in FF Agent (web UI > Automation > Personal webhooks) that the header X-FF-Agent-Token with the token of this entry is set. If you use Home Assistant Cloud (Nabu Casa) and the header does not arrive, switch off the option to require the additional token in the options of this entry.

This notice disappears with the next accepted call.
